## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 65 captures during November 2022. The activity was completed as part of the site’s routine primary care work. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issue was reported in the information provided. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 65 captures, 3 were marked ungradable by the graders. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.6 per cent of captures. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, although the ungradable images should remain under routine review so that any recurring quality issues can be identified and addressed through normal service arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. These results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings when reviewing the month’s activity. The figures provide a concise summary of throughput, image suitability and grading timeliness for Oakridge Primary Care in November 2022. Further follow-up of referable results should proceed through the established clinical pathway.
